summary: Async systems require explicit control over events, retries, ordering, and observability.
youtube_description:
Async systems require explicit control over events, retries, ordering, and observability. The lecture frames the pressure model, state transitions, and trade-offs that matter when work moves across time and the design has to defend its invariant with evidence.

This CS 5254 Week 9 lecture explores designing async systems and its impact on concurrent system design.
